# Psalm 106 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Praise Yah! Give-thanks to-YHWH for good, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**2** Who can-utter the-mighty-deeds-of YHWH? Who-can-proclaim all his-praise?

**3** Blessed the-keepers-of justice, the-doer-of righteousness at-all times.

**4** Remember-me O-YHWH in-favor-of your-people; visit-me with-your-salvation,

**5** To-see in-goodness-of your-chosen-ones, to-rejoice in-gladness-of your-nation, to-boast with-your-inheritance.

**6** We-have-sinned with-our-fathers; we-have-committed-iniquity; we-have-acted-wickedly.

**7** Our-fathers in-Egypt not understood your-wonders; not they-remembered the-abundance-of your-steadfast-love; and-they-rebelled at-the-sea, at-the-Sea-of Reeds.

**8** And-he-saved-them for-sake-of his-name, to-make-known his-might.

**9** And-he-rebuked the-Sea-of Reeds and-it-dried-up; and-he-led-them through-the-depths as-through-the-wilderness.

**10** And-he-saved-them from-hand-of the-hater, and-he-redeemed-them from-hand-of the-enemy.

**11** And-covered the-waters their-adversaries; one-of-them not was-left.

**12** And-they-believed his-words; they-sang his-praise.

**13** Quickly they-forgot his-deeds; not they-waited for-his-counsel.

**14** And-they-craved a-craving in-the-wilderness, and-they-tested God in-the-wasteland.

**15** And-he-gave to-them their-request, and-he-sent leanness into-their-soul.

**16** And-they-were-jealous-of Moses in-the-camp, of-Aaron the-holy-one-of YHWH.

**17** Opened the-earth and-swallowed Dathan, and-covered the-company-of Abiram.

**18** And-burned a-fire in-their-company; a-flame consumed the-wicked.

**19** They-made a-calf in-Horeb, and-bowed-down to-a-molten-image.

**20** And-they-exchanged their-glory for-image-of an-ox eating grass.

**21** They-forgot God their-savior, the-doer-of great-things in-Egypt,

**22** Wonders in-land-of Ham, fearsome-things at the-Sea-of Reeds.

**23** And-he-said to-destroy-them, if-not Moses his-chosen had-stood in-the-breach before-him, to-turn-back his-wrath from-destroying.

**24** And-they-despised the-land-of desire; not they-believed his-word.

**25** And-they-grumbled in-their-tents; not they-listened to-voice-of YHWH.

**26** And-he-lifted his-hand to-them, to-fell-them in-the-wilderness,

**27** And-to-fell their-seed among-the-nations, and-to-scatter-them in-the-lands.

**28** And-they-yoked-themselves to-Baal-of-Peor, and-they-ate sacrifices-of the-dead.

**29** And-they-provoked with-their-deeds, and-broke-out among-them a-plague.

**30** And-stood-up Phinehas and-he-intervened, and-was-restrained the-plague.

**31** And-it-was-counted to-him as-righteousness, to-generation and-generation to-forever.

**32** And-they-angered at-the-waters-of Meribah, and-it-went-badly for-Moses on-their-account.

**33** For they-embittered his-spirit, and-he-spoke-rashly with-his-lips.

**34** Not they-destroyed the-peoples, which had-said YHWH to-them,

**35** And-they-mingled with-the-nations, and-they-learned their-deeds.

**36** And-they-served their-idols, and-they-became to-them a-snare.

**37** And-they-sacrificed their-sons and-their-daughters to-the-demons.

**38** And-they-shed blood innocent, blood-of their-sons and-their-daughters, whom they-sacrificed to-idols-of Canaan; and-was-polluted the-land with-blood.

**39** And-they-became-unclean by-their-deeds, and-they-played-the-harlot in-their-doings.

**40** And-burned the-anger-of YHWH against-his-people, and-he-abhorred his-inheritance.

**41** And-he-gave-them into-hand-of the-nations, and-ruled-over-them those-hating-them.

**42** And-oppressed-them their-enemies, and-they-were-subdued under their-hand.

**43** Many-times he-delivered-them, and-they rebelled in-their-counsel, and-they-sank in-their-iniquity.

**44** And-he-looked on-their-distress, when-he-heard their-cry.

**45** And-he-remembered for-them his-covenant, and-he-relented according-to-abundance-of his-steadfast-love.

**46** And-he-gave-them to-compassion before all their-captors.

**47** Save-us O-YHWH our-God, and-gather-us from-the-nations, to-give-thanks to-name-of your-holiness, to-glory in-your-praise.

**48** Blessed YHWH God-of Israel from the-everlasting and-to the-everlasting. And-say all the-people 'Amen!' Praise Yah!

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **106:20**: 'They-exchanged their-glory for-image-of an-ox' — echoed by Paul in Romans 1:23; the primal exchange of truth for falsehood.

- **106:23**: Moses 'stood in-the-breach' — intercessory language; Moses as mediator between divine wrath and human sin.

- **106:48**: Doxology closing Book IV of the Psalter (Psalms 90-106). 'And-say all the-people Amen!' — congregational response.

— EMET
